title: Intrinsic normalized scalar associators commute with integer shifts
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and an arbitrary scheme $Y$, with the universes of $Y$ and $\Omega$ independent. Let $I$ be the directed poset of finite coefficient subfields of $\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Use the specified small coefficient models, the intrinsic raw rational categories $C_E=D^b_c(Y,E)$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and the datum-free stage system of [lem-general-algebraically-closed-coefficient-stages]. For $E\le L$ write $T_{EL}:C_E\to C_L$ for its actual scalar transition and $\sigma_{EL,n,K}:T_{EL}(K[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}(T_{EL}K)[n]$ for its uniquely integral-image-normalized coherent integer-shift comparison. For $E\le L\le M$ let $a_{ELM}:T_{LM}T_{EL}\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{EM}$ be the specified tensor associator. Then for every $n\in\mathbf Z$ and $K\in C_E$,
$$\sigma_{EM,n,K}\circ a_{ELM,K[n]}=a_{ELM,K}[n]\circ\sigma_{LM,n,T_{EL}K}\circ T_{LM}(\sigma_{EL,n,K}).$$
The equality is in $C_M$ and uses these precise associators and comparisons, including when indices repeat. Equivalently the hom natural transformation of $a_{ELM}$ commutes with integer shifts, with the composite comparison on $T_{LM}T_{EL}$ and the specified comparison on $T_{EM}$. No finite-field datum, base-field structure on $Y$, noetherian hypothesis, or Karoubi completion is assumed.

proof.text: For any natural transformation between coherent integer-shift functors, CommShiftCore holds at zero and is closed under addition. Compatibility at n implies compatibility at -n: apply the faithful shift by n, expand the addition equations at -n+n=0, use naturality of the shift-addition comparison, and cancel the invertible comparisons. Integer induction using the degree-one and degree-minus-one squares gives CommShiftCore at every integer; apply NatTrans.CommShift.of_core.
